decided year by year under no
a mix of the conditions fitted

g.text: b to g: what the data look like at each component; values illustrative
captures per year and page role
every page carries a Common Crawl pointer
fetch the same page and repeat the coding
per firm and year: 15 to 50 pages read,
up to 45,000 characters, by page role
a stated result, with its quote
“… now in use at forty sites” — verbatim, or it is not kept
what the agent reads in year t
stated strategy and situation, from its website
what management weighs when results come in
A: own page, result stated · B: mentioned only
“B falls short of aspiration and ties up resources
the core line needs …” p: probability of withdrawal
probability of withdrawal in year t, five copies of one firm
one row per product and decision year; the agent
never sees the year it decides about
every cell keeps the reason the agent gave,
so a theory can be read at work
BTF behavioral theory · AC absorptive capacity
fit the mix: products of 2018, decided 2019
regime and firm weights shrink toward the common mix
scored by level, log loss and ranking against the record
swap the text, keep the firm
the firm reduced to industry, size, age
its own first-year decisions as its past
own history: share of the first-year cohort still on the market
